text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD#INC-20260314-4831 -> high 5xx ratio for model-serving in us-west-2 az2. Alerts: error_rate>10% for 2min, queue depth x4. Runbook: /runbooks/region-az-degradation.md. P1. Please ack.

pagerduty: Assigned to SRE oncall (sre-oncall). Paging now.

sre-oncall: Acked. Kicking off triage. Tagging infra and platform. @dinesh (infra) @emma (platform)

dinesh (infra): Checking instance provisioning and autoscaler events. Seeing repeated create failures for GPU nodes in us-west-2a/az2. Cloud API returning 429 (rate-limited) and occasional 503.

emma (platform): Noted large burst of service-creation attempts ~5m ago from batch rebalancer. Could be a feedback loop with autoscaler. Looking at throttle logs.

sre-oncall: Likely provider-side control-plane throttling causing pod/node provisioning to stall -> backlog -> request errors. For now, disable autoscaler onboarding in az2 and trigger cross-az traffic steering.

ops-bot: Running play: 
```
infractl policy apply --name cross-az-steer --from az2 --to az3,az4 --drain=graceful
autoscalerctl set-mode --zone us-west-2/az2 --mode paused
```

lucy (prod-ops): FYI: steering traffic will increase p95 by ~30ms for affected customers. Publishing initial status update.

mia (acct-eng): I'll message top-10 accounts in us-west with human note. We should include mitigation and ETA.

ops-bot: Traffic steering applied. Current distribution: az2=18%, az3=52%, az4=30%. Error rates dropping in az3/az4, still high for az2.

sre-oncall: Switching critical routes to quantized-fallback model (rwd-large-q4_1) for capacity constrained nodes to avoid OOMs. Deploying now.

dinesh (infra): Deploy command: 
```
service deploy inference-model --variant rwd-large-q4_1 --target-route "critical-realtime" --parallel 4
```

emma (platform): Also applying increased connection retries + jitter at gateway layer to tolerate short-term failures.

ops-bot: Gateway config change: 
```
gwctl set retries --service inference --count 5 --backoff 250ms --jitter 0.2
```

lucy (prod-ops): Status page draft v1 posted (public): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-4831

mia (acct-eng): Sent targeted emails to impacted customers. Logged responses; one enterprise customer requested SLA escalation. Passing to sales ops.

sre-oncall: Cloud provider case opened (CP-22198). Provider response: investigating control-plane throttling in us-west-2, estimated mitigation 1-2h.

ops-bot: Running diagnostic collection to bucket: s3://incidents/INC-4831/diagnostics-2170000123.tar.gz

dinesh (infra): Observed unusual provisioning burst from internal reconciliation job. I've paused the job and rolled back a recent autoscaler tuning change from yesterday.

emma (platform): Confirmed rollback of autoscaler tuning -> should reduce create/delete storms. Monitoring node churn metric.

sre-oncall: Next steps: 1) maintain cross-az steering 2) keep autoscaler paused in az2 until provider confirms 3) maintain degraded model variant for critical traffic 4) update customers every 30m.

incident-bot: Escalation timer: 20m remaining before auto-escalate to Eng Director.

lucy (prod-ops): Adding note to status: degraded performance, partial failover to other AZs, no data loss.

mia (acct-eng): Customer update sent at T+10m. Will send follow-ups.

dinesh (infra): Provider notified request to throttle was likely triggered by our reconciliation job hitting rate limits. They've flagged our case for accelerated review.

ops-bot: Safety action: suppress non-P1 alerts for related autoscaler checks to reduce noise.

emma (platform): Quick check: memory/cpu for fallback model stable. Throughput improved on az3/az4.

sre-oncall: Scheduling 1:1 handoff to night oncall (dinesh-night) in 35m. @dinesh (infra) can you take over if needed?

dinesh (infra): Can do. Will watch provisioning and the provider case.

lucy (prod-ops): Preparing post-incident template and will capture timeline once stabilized.

incident-bot: Incident timer at 00:17:45. Keep thread updated.

ops-bot: Final note: once provider confirms control-plane rate limiting cleared, we'll gradually unpause autoscaler and revert traffic steering. Plan for canary re-enable first.

sre-oncall: Appreciate the quick responses. I'll post a short summary and timeline after we reach steady state. Leaving thread open for updates.

emma (platform): I'll keep live dashboards pinned and alert if error_rate rises above 3% in any AZ. :eyes:
